details: Bitcoin and Ethereum have fallen to their lowest levels since August, with Bitcoin sliding towards $73,700 and Ethereum below $2,100. The downturn is attributed to significant long liquidations (over $1 billion), $1.28 billion in net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, concerns over stricter US cryptocurrency regulations following the recent midterm elections, a broader tech stock rout, and a reported $6.3 billion hack on Binance. The crypto Fear & Greed Index is currently at 29, signaling market fear.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Drop to August Lows on ETF Outflows, Regulatory Fears

details: The Ethereum community has submitted EIP-8488, "Versioned Opcodes for Gas Repricing," as part of the upcoming "Glamsterdam" upgrade. This proposal introduces parallel V2 opcodes with new gas pricing rules (EIP-8037 and EIP-8038) to address the challenge of upgrading gas rules while maintaining compatibility with existing contracts. It aims to allow new contracts to adopt updated pricing without affecting older ones, potentially impacting around 200,000 existing contracts.
title: Ethereum Community Proposes EIP-8488 to Redefine Gas Pricing

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has articulated a clearer long-term vision for ETH, framing it more as a store of value rather than a token whose value primarily depends on continuous fee burning. This narrative shift invites comparisons to Bitcoin's role as digital gold.
title: Vitalik Buterin Re-frames Ethereum's ETH as a Store of Value

details: Public companies collectively sold 11,647 Bitcoin, valued at approximately $869 million, between November 2 and 8, 2026, with Hut 8 and Next Technology Holding being major sellers. This substantial sell-off contributed to market concerns. Conversely, Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced holdings of 6.07 million ETH, representing 4.97% of the total ETH supply, and has staked 5.2 million ETH, bringing its total crypto, cash, and marketable securities to $14.3 billion as of November 8, 2026.
title: Public Companies Sell $869M Bitcoin, Bitmine Accumulates 6M ETH
